integrity: The characteristic-zero results and the known 256-node count are expressly prior work. New arithmetic-specialization claim is supported by the integer incidence classification and geometric covering proof. One older finite-field thesis could be inspected only by abstract; historical priority is provisional. No independent audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Over algebraically closed fields of characteristic different from two only. The natural automorphism subgroup in characteristic three is not claimed to be full. Does not compute finite-field rational points, Picard lattices or characteristic-two geometry.
title: A characteristic-three symmetry jump on the magic-square-of-squares surface
